extractions.quote: She received seven courses of intravenous immunoglobulin from November 2001 to May 2003; Cyclophosphamide was introduced in May 2002 with some benefit but had to be withdrawn because of severe neutropenia. Mycophenolate mofetil was started in May 2003 at a dose of 500 mg twice daily and was initially effective but later had to be escalated to 1 g twice daily then to 1.5 g twice daily in November 2003 due to recurrence of symptoms. It was discontinued in December 2003 because the dose was no longer controlling the disease. She was then given once weekly infusions of intrathecal hydrocortisone (500 mg) for four weeks; Rituximab was administered intravenously on 9 January 2004 at a dose of 375 mg/m2; she was readmitted and given a four week course of intravenous rituximab in the same dosage at weekly intervals
